card.name: Hold dosing until recovery
card.fires_on: The word "until" right after a hold, interrupt, withhold or stop instruction in dose-modification text. It also fires on a few number and duration spots like "erection" before a persisting-hours phrase.

modes.label: Until after hold/interrupt
modes.description: "until" follows a verb or noun for pausing treatment, introducing the recovery condition.
modes.example: Interrupt dosing<< until>> ANC is greater than 1,0

modes.label: Duration or range spots
modes.description: Occasional hits on a noun or number just before a time or amount phrase.
modes.example: In the event of an<< erection>> that persists longer than 4 hours,

card.writes: It seems to suppress words about intervals, short time spans and waiting periods, so the text after it is less likely to name a time gap.
card.plain: It marks the word "until" in instructions to pause a drug until a lab value or symptom recovers.
